info.title: Unique Domains API
info.description: Domain intelligence from the Unique Domains catalog: names, words, endings, registrars, the market, trends and the agenda.

tags.name: names
tags.description: Domain Check: Any domain name: status, registry record, DNS, prices, value, past sales and its open auction.

tags.name: words
tags.description: Word Intelligence: The one-word catalog: profiles, endings, names, trademarks, notability, market and the word intake.

tags.name: catalog
tags.description: Domain Catalog: The tracked one-word names: filtered lists, expiring names, drops, hacks, the change feed and catalog totals.

tags.name: tlds
tags.description: TLD Intelligence: Every ending: registry facts, phases, market statistics, changes, keywords and the ICANN applications.

tags.name: registrars
tags.description: Registrar Prices: Registrar price lists, price changes, renewal traps, cheapest registrars, venues and the IANA registrar list.

tags.name: market
tags.description: Domain Market: Domain sales as aggregates and the day's domain auctions.

tags.name: trends
tags.description: Trends: The trends behind the daily editions: definitions, searches, growth and categories.

tags.name: agenda
tags.description: Agenda: Industry events and the dated agenda of TLD phases and registry changes, in JSON or iCalendar.

tags.name: shared
tags.description: The `/meta` and `/editions` paths, in every listing.

get.summary: The stored answer for one domain name: status, drop day, price today, registry facts, word facts and similar sales.
get.description: Read from the stored lookup rows, never live (`POST /names/{name}/check` is the live path). Free carries the website lookup's public contract: the rating as a band, no value, no checked time. Keyed adds the regular price behind a promotion, the exact rating, the verdict and the value facts. A name the catalog never stored answers 200 with `tracked: false` and empty facts, never 404.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: A full domain name on an ending the catalog holds, lowercased, IDN as punycode. A bare word, a subdomain, an e-mail address or an unknown ending answers 400 `validation_failed` with `reason` and `suggestion`.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: id, name, ending, tracked, status, lifecycle, drop, ownableNow, price, registry, parking, length, format, shape, word, rating, verdict, value, comps.

200.description: The stored answer for one domain name: status, drop day, price today, registry facts, word facts and similar sales.

parking.description: The parking or sale venue id.

tier.description: `sold_before` (this exact name sold before) on keyed answers only.

endingsSoldOn.description: Endings the word sold on in 12 months.

post.summary: The keyed name resource for up to 100 names in one call.
post.description: One entry per name, in the request's order: the keyed `GET /names/{name}` resource, `{ name, tracked: false }` for a name the catalog never stored, or `{ name, error: "validation_failed" }` for an entry that is not a name. No live read. Billed one request per name sent, refused entries included.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: id, name, ending, tracked, status, lifecycle, drop, ownableNow, price, registry, parking, length, format, shape, word, rating, verdict, value, comps, error.

200.description: The keyed name resource for up to 100 names in one call.

parking.description: The parking or sale venue id.

tier.description: `sold_before` (this exact name sold before) on keyed answers only.

endingsSoldOn.description: Endings the word sold on in 12 months.

post.summary: Reads one name live from its registry and a registrar, stores the answer and returns the keyed name resource.
post.description: Billed `Live=1` when the live read answered (200, `checked: true`) or when the registry was asked and did not conclude (202); `Live=0` when the answer came from storage (200, `checked: false`). Asking `value` or `history` answers 202 with the stored resource so far, `Retry-After: 30` and `Location`; the check never runs the appraisal (`POST /names/{name}/appraise` does). 2,000 live checks a UTC day for the whole API, 200 per consumer.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: A full domain name on an ending the catalog holds, lowercased, IDN as punycode. A bare word, a subdomain, an e-mail address or an unknown ending answers 400 `validation_failed` with `reason` and `suggestion`.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: id, name, ending, tracked, status, lifecycle, drop, ownableNow, price, registry, parking, length, format, shape, word, rating, verdict, value, comps, checked.

requestBody.description: Optional: the lanes to read. `prices` asks every registrar, `registry` forces the registry record. Default `["availability","registry","dns","prices"]`.

200.description: Reads one name live from its registry and a registrar, stores the answer and returns the keyed name resource.

parking.description: The parking or sale venue id.

tier.description: `sold_before` (this exact name sold before) on keyed answers only.

endingsSoldOn.description: Endings the word sold on in 12 months.

parameters.name: name

post.summary: Runs the appraisal of one stored name when its estimate is missing, and returns the value resource.
post.description: A fresh estimate answers 200 with `Appraisal=0` and no run. A run this call started answers 200 with `Appraisal=1`; a run another call holds answers 202 with `Retry-After: 30` and `Appraisal=0`, and a run another call finished meanwhile 200 with `Appraisal=0`. The name must be stored: run `POST /names/{name}/check` first. 5,000 runs a UTC day for the whole API.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: A full domain name on an ending the catalog holds, lowercased, IDN as punycode. A bare word, a subdomain, an e-mail address or an unknown ending answers 400 `validation_failed` with `reason` and `suggestion`.

parameters.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: current, history.

get.description: `data` is null without an open listing. The venue is named by id and label; the first-year cost only when the venue's rule is verified; `bidsJumped` when the bid count rose in the last 24 hours.

get.summary: Turns what a caller typed into the catalog word it names, or up to five candidates.
get.description: Tries the spelling as typed, its lowercase, accents stripped, spaces and hyphens removed, one inflection suffix stripped, then the lookalike spelling. A miss answers 200 with `candidates` (words starting with the query), never 404. Words with a deny class are never a match nor a candidate.

parameters.description: What the caller typed, 1 to 255 characters.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: match, candidates.

200.description: Turns what a caller typed into the catalog word it names, or up to five candidates.

get.description: The `category` filter values of `GET /words`. The catch-all `general` category is left out, as on the profile. The whole list, no cursor.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: slug, name.

pos.description: Parts of speech as stored, comma-joined tags.

popularity.description: How widely the word is used; never sales or demand.

addedAt.description: When the intake added it; null means the dictionary load.

parameters.description: The catalog slug, the word, or `wrd_<id>`.

parameters.name: status

parameters.name: limit

parameters.name: tld
parameters.description: One bare ending.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows, 1 to 50.

parameters.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: ending, fit, basis.

post.summary: Brings a word into the catalog: checks it now and queues an accepted word for the intake.
post.description: Billed `Intake=1` only when the gate accepted the word (202 `accepted`, `Retry-After: 600`, poll the request); a word already in the catalog answers 200 `in_catalog`, a queued one 202 `queued` with its request id, a refused one 422 with the reason as `code` (`not_a_word`, `brand`, `offensive`), all billed `Intake=0`. 10 words a UTC day per consumer and 100 for the whole API, refused words included. When the gate cannot answer: 503 `gate_unavailable`, `Retry-After: 60`, never billed.

parameters.name: word
parameters.description: One lowercase word of 2 to 63 letters a to z; no slug or id form.

200.description: Brings a word into the catalog: checks it now and queues an accepted word for the intake.

202.description: Accepted: the answer so far; poll `Location` after `Retry-After` seconds.

get.summary: The state of a word request: queued, ready with its catalog word, refused or failed.
get.description: Reads the request by its id. `queued` while the intake has not finished; `ready` names the catalog word and whether its first scan of every ending ran; `rejected` the reason code. Not metered.

parameters.name: requestId
parameters.description: The id the request answered.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: requestId, status, word, scan, reason, requestedAt, resolvedAt.

200.description: The state of a word request: queued, ready with its catalog word, refused or failed.

word.description: On `ready`; null when the catalog no longer serves the word.

scan.description: On `ready` with a word: whether the first scan of every ending ran.

get.summary: One-word catalog names under filters.
get.description: Free: at most 20 rows in the engine's neutral order (the cached public list, or the daily shuffle under filters), one page. Keyed: pages of up to 100 in a neutral column order with `sort`, else in the engine's own order, with the estimate, Est. profit, liquidity and verdict on each row.

parameters.name: shape

parameters.name: style

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: One word, or domain hacks.

parameters.name: priceMax

parameters.name: renewalMax
parameters.description: Highest renewal, USD.

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: The word starts with. Paid subscriptions only.

parameters.name: contains
parameters.description: The word contains. Paid subscriptions only.

parameters.name: pos
parameters.description: Comma list of parts of speech: adjective, adjective satellite, adverb, conjunction, contraction, determiner, interjection, letter, noun, particle, pnoun, pnound, preposition, prepPhrase, pronoun, proverb, symbol, verb, unknown.

parameters.name: expiresBefore

parameters.name: limit
